name: luu-ui
description: Optional browser dependencies for the debug UI. Nothing here is required: the page draws every file itself, and `monaco-editor` is the opt-in the General settings offer where somebody installed it, and `@xterm/xterm` with its fit addon is what draws the terminal panel (RECORD/2026-10-01.a-terminal-in-the-container.completed.md). Kept as a node dependency rather than vendored into the tree for the reason the icon themes are not vendored either — name what the machine has, ship nothing. See RECORD/2026-09-16.three-columns-that-each-have-a-footer.completed.md.
